verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is early testers reporting that Instinct outperformed expectations at 'cleaning up inboxes', a task that implies acting on many emails at once. Vendor docs never describe batch or bulk actions, and the 'delete all data indexed' setting is a privacy control rather than a user-directed bulk operation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of bulk/batch operations, evidence of operating across many items in apps beyond email, limits and scale of bulk actions, and detailed hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Testers said it outperformed their expectations at tasks like booking appointments, cleaning up inboxes and finding cheap flights.
